response.headline: Belgian cybersecurity startup Aikido hits unicorn status with new funding round

Founded in 2022, Aikido's security software helps developers detect and address risk automatically. It counts mobile app ⁠and game developer ‌Niantic, fintech Revolut and music streaming platform SoundCloud among its customers.
